edition: Paderewski / Bronarski / Turczynski (PWM): model-reviewed pitches, attacks, rhythm and dynamic levels; not a facsimile edition
provenance: NIFC Breitkopf & Hartel first-edition encoding, corrected by a complete model review of both staves against Paderewski Waltzes PDF pp.59-64; original source retained.
licence: First Editions of Fryderyk Chopin's Music; Copyright 2017-2021 The Fryderyk Chopin Institute; https://nifc.pl ; https://chopinscores.org ; https://github.com/pl-wnifc/humdrum-chopin-first-editions ; CC BY 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/ . Derived corrections are separate; no scan redistributed.
verified_scope: written pitches, accidentals and sounding octaves
chord membership, independent voices and attack order
written small notes and upper mordent symbols
eight-note tuplet at 84 and triplet at 85
omitted_or_unverified_scope: facsimile engraving, including mid-measure key and octave-line placement
unmarked opening loudness: no invented p level
corrections: Move the source extra pickup bar 0 after 64 into the final beat of printed 64, replacing its extra rest; remove the empty remainder of that inserted bar. Keep the original opening pickup 0.
Restore the Db-major key (five flats) for the Più lento section at the pickup on the last beat of 64; original converted score cancels the C-sharp-minor key but omits the new signature.
Restore the printed upper-voice ties 27-28 and 29-30, and their reprise counterparts 155-156 and 157-158.
Restore dotted-quarter C6 and final eighth-note Bb5 in 93.
Add the missing G#4 quarter at beat 3 of 159, tied into a separate half-note voice in 160, preserving the moving E4/D#4 and C#4 voices.
Encode the eight-note group in 84 as eight eighth notes in the time of six, rather than dotted sixteenths. Exact total duration remains three quarter beats.
Correct the upper mordent symbols in 30/80/158 (unbarred zigzag in the scan); retain all written grace notes.
Add only written pp/mf/p levels, including parenthetical mf and p, and the printed tempo changes. Preserve all repeated written-out returns through 192.
